votes.motion: Commissioner Hawker made a motion to approve the Site Plan on the South Mountain Golf Course property that contains the Golf Course Club House for the development of an event center. The property is located at 1247 E Mike Weir Dr. Application SPR-994-2020, based on findings of staff report and Commissioner Player seconded the motion Vote: A roll call vote was taken with Commissioners voting unanimously against the motion.
